# SFCC-89 / PR #57 — Consolidated Findings

Investigation date: 2026-08-22. Repo: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`.
Branch: `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-ui-static-product-information` @ `d526ad1`.

This is the authoritative summary. Five deeper reports sit alongside it in the same folder:
`req-jira.md`, `req-figma.md`, `code-state.md`, `pr57-review.md`, `conventions.md`, plus
`pr57-body.md` (the PR description verbatim).

---

## 0. Situation

We are **taking over an in-flight PR authored by someone else**. PR #57
"feat(pdp): SFCC-89 — PDP UI static product information", author **JhoanDelaCruz**,
opened 2026-08-18, last pushed 2026-08-21. 24 commits, +1702/−99 across 30 files.
Base `develop`. State OPEN / `CHANGES_REQUESTED` / `MERGEABLE` / `BLOCKED`.
0 commits behind develop.

The four scope decisions (page composition, ticket ownership, sanitiser, PR strategy)
have been **deliberately deferred by the FED Lead**. Work continues on the existing
branch for now. No code has been changed. No commits. No pushes.

---

## 1. What SFCC-89 asks for

Story, High, 5 points, Sprint 3 (10–24 Aug), status **Code Review**, assignee Jhoan
Rose Dela Cruz, reporter Jasmijn Tsang, due 17 Aug (overdue). Parent epic **SFCC-5
(PDP)** — a Level 2 *page* epic.

**The acceptance criteria are in a custom field (`customfield_10231`), not the
description** — easy to miss entirely. Six Given/When/Then items:

1. Product name
2. Price — single full price, in storefront currency
3. Description
4. Style code
5. Model copy ("Model is…"), including the negative case (no empty placeholder)
6. Breadcrumb beneath the product images: `HOME / NEW / DRESSES / [PRODUCT NAME]`,
   nodes navigate to category

Two further styling ACs live in standalone Tasks **SFCC-732 / SFCC-733** (both To Do),
citing Figma node `5804-170721`. They assert `.product-name` / `.product-price` CSS
selectors that **the component does not expose** — values match, selectors do not, so
they fail at QA as written.

**Explicitly out of scope**, with owning tickets: badges (SFCC-132/225), was/now pricing
(SFCC-194), wishlist (SFCC-434), colour swatches (SFCC-91), size + add-to-bag (SFCC-92),
Find in Boutique (SFCC-297), image gallery (SFCC-186/187/188), accordions
(SFCC-195/102/267/266).

---

## 2. Findings ranked by severity

### P0-A — Merging this removes the storefront PDP

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (95 lines) replaces the base SFCC PDP
(876 lines). It renders exactly three things: an empty grey `<Box>` placeholder for the
gallery (`:56`), `<PdpProductInfo>` (`:74`), and the breadcrumb toolbar (`:85`).

Everything else in the base page disappears: `ProductView` (add-to-bag, swatches,
quantity picker), `RecommendedProducts`, `InformationAccordion`, `<Helmet>`/`<Seo>`,
`HTTPNotFound` 404 handling, SSR cache headers, `<Island>` hydration, and the full
`useProduct` expand list.

**Two independent shadowing mechanisms, so deleting the route entry does not fix it:**
1. `overrides/app/routes.tsx:37` registers `/product/:productId` before `..._routes`.
2. The override mirrors the base path exactly, so `ccExtensibility` redirects base
   `routes.jsx:43`'s own `import('./pages/product-detail')` to the override too.

Verified directly, not inferred. Nothing in the PR body acknowledges this.

### P0-B — The PDP throws on every SSR request, and the cause is the unapproved dependency

CI artifact shows, for every `/product/*` request, valid and invalid SKU alike:

```
ReferenceError: Cannot access '__WEBPACK_DEFAULT_EXPORT__' before initialization
    at Module.default (build/main-server.js:71360:42)
```

**Root cause established by direct inspection.** `isomorphic-dompurify`'s node entry
(`dist/index.mjs`) instantiates JSDOM at module-evaluation time:

```js
import { JSDOM } from "jsdom";
var window = new JSDOM("<!DOCTYPE html>").window;   // runs on import
var purify = DOMPurifyFactory(window);
```

`overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:2` imports it at module scope. Bundled
into `main-server.js`, jsdom's CommonJS interop produces `__WEBPACK_DEFAULT_EXPORT__`, and
the module-scope `new JSDOM()` executes before that binding initialises. Explains every
symptom: PDP-only, SKU-independent, homepage unaffected, and a *build* that succeeds
because this is an evaluation-order failure, not a compile error.

Consequence: Playwright went **0-for-7** on PDP scenarios (6 retries exhausted, 2 skipped)
then hit the 15-minute job timeout; `mobile-chrome` never ran; no HTML report produced.
**The PR body attributes these failures to missing sandbox products. That is not what is
happening.**

I ruled out a circular import in our own code: a value-import cycle scan across
`overrides/app` (110 modules reachable from the PDP entry, resolving base-package imports
through the override redirect) found **no cycles**. The only two hits were override files
importing their own base path, which is the documented PWA Kit self-reference pattern.

### P0-C — Tier 1 dependency added without approval

`package.json` gains `isomorphic-dompurify@^3.19.0` as a **production** dependency
(commit `0068e1a`). `package.json` is Tier 1 frozen; AGENTS.md Hard Rule #7 forbids adding
packages without Integration team approval. **The PR body itself states the approval is
needed and has not been obtained** — then the dependency was added anyway.

Context: the repo has only **four** production dependencies total. The lockfile shows the
install flipped a chain of jsdom-related packages (`@asamuzakjp/*` and others) from
`dev: true` into the production tree. 16 MB installed, jsdom ~12 MB.

Scope of the actual need is tiny: **two** `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` sites, both in
`pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` (`:43` description, `:54` model info). Nothing else in
`overrides/` uses it.

**Measured, not assumed:** I ran `npm run build`. It succeeds. Bundle budgets **pass** —
`main.js` 103.46 KB gzip (limit 180 KB), `vendor.js` 524.74 KB gzip (limit 550 KB).
Note vendor is at **95.4% of budget** with ~25 KB headroom. No circular-dependency warning
was emitted, but webpack does not emit those by default.

### P1 — Multi-tier change (Hard Rule #10)

- **Tier 1:** `package.json`, `package-lock.json`
- **Tier 2:** `routes.tsx`, `theme/components/index.ts`, `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`
  (owner: **UI Designer** — not notified)
- Clean: `.github/workflows/`, `config/`, `.storybook/`, `theme/foundation/`, `ssr.js`,
  and every Tier 2 shared-product component.

The PR body's changed-files table lists **15 files and omits every Tier 1 file**. The real
diff is 30 files.

### P1 — Ownership contradiction between two governance files

- `CODEOWNERS:159` → `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` → **`@ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-b`**
- `.claude/rules/squadA.md` lists the same path as **Squad A** territory

CODEOWNERS is the enforcement surface, so GitHub will require a Squad B review regardless.
This PR also reclassifies ProductDetail to Squad A in the generated registry. Unresolved.

### P1 — Breadcrumb silently restyles the PLP

`overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/` shadows a **shared SFCC component** consumed by
`product-view/index.jsx:75` and `product-list/partials/page-header.jsx:20`. Effects:
chevron separator → `/`, theme config → hardcoded styles, `...rest` dropped, `categories`
made required. Violates the SFCC bridge-pattern rule in `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`
(shared components must keep a faithful, undecorated default export; brand styling goes
behind a named export or a theme recipe).

*Ruled out:* a suspected locale-URL regression — base `categoryUrlBuilder` ignores its
locale argument, so the inlined copy is behaviourally identical.

### P1 — No human has reviewed this PR

All **8 reviews and all 22 inline threads are `coderabbitai[bot]`**. The
`CHANGES_REQUESTED` decision is entirely the bot's. Five reviewer teams were requested —
PWA Squad A, PWA Squad B, PWA QA, Tier-1 Approvers, Tier-2 Approvers — **none responded**.
The only human comments are the author's own note about a BrowserStack secret and
`marcelannavarro` typing `@coderabbitai full-review`.

---

## 3. Acceptance-criteria conformance

| AC | State | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| Product name | Built | `h1` has no `data-testid` while all four siblings do; SFCC-732 asserts `.product-name`, which does not exist |
| Price — single full price | Partial | Uses `product.price` (current price, not necessarily full). When `currency` is absent, renders `''` — an empty element that still occupies layout instead of being omitted |
| Description | Partial | `shortDescription \|\| longDescription` (`page:77`) is a guess; the AC does not say which field |
| Style code | **Wrong source** | Reads `product?.id` (`page:79`). SFCC-26 defines style code as the **master** ID / `styleNumber`. Latent until SFCC-91 adds colour-variant routing, then silently wrong |
| Model copy + negative case | **Wrong source** | Reads `c_sizeFit`, not the `modelFit` attribute SFCC-26 created specifically for this line. Jasmijn's comments confirm `modelFit` was deliberate. `sizeFit` belongs to the Size & Fit tab (SFCC-102, out of scope) |
| Breadcrumb | Partial | Leaf category omitted; no `BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD (the whole point of SFCC-578); `Home` hardcoded |

`extractModelLine` (`overrides/app/utils/productData.ts`) is:

```ts
const match = html.match(/<li>\s*(Model is[^<]*?)\s*<\/li>/i);
```

Two defects: matches only a **bare** `<li>` (any attribute breaks it), and matches only the
**English** string. Returns `undefined` on 10 of 11 locales.

---

## 4. Figma design spec

Design: `QQ427wHWEUjsjP7H8v48Rs` (composed page states), node `3087:15747`.
**Never cross-compare with `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` (the design system file).**

**Two corrections to the original brief:**
- `3087:15747` is a **PAGE**, not a screen — 67 children, 108649×41878 px.
- Only **402** and **1440** frames exist. **No 1023 frame. Tablet is undesigned.**
  Repo breakpoints are `md 768` / `xl 1280`; **no `860` token exists anywhere in the theme.**

**Tooling limits hit:** `get_variable_defs` and `get_design_context` resolve against the
Figma **desktop app's current selection** and ignore the `nodeId` argument — both returned
"You currently have nothing selected". Substituted read-only Plugin API traversal, which
gives resolved variable names/collections/modes rather than pre-rendered Tailwind.
`get_metadata` on the target fails deterministically (subtree >315 KB vs the SSE cap). A
non-ASCII character in some layer names breaks SSE encoding outright.

**Measurement rules applied.** TEXT nodes report a cap-height box, not comparable to a CSS
line box. FRAMES/INSTANCES report real boxes and are comparable. A **third case** was
found that the brief did not cover: **a FRAME that hugs a TEXT child inherits the
cap-height artifact** — accordion rows report `218x9`, which is text cap-height, not row
height (real pitch ≈ 25.5 px). Uniform residual = artifact; varying residual = defect.

### Matches
Seven text styles map exactly (`heading3`, `price`, `body2`, `caption`, `linkLg`,
`linkSm`, `button`), four colour tokens, spacing 2/4/8/16/24/30/80. The DS spacing scale
is **1:1 identical** to `spacing.ts`.

### Layout — measured vs code

| Value | Figma | Code | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Column gap | 179px | `--zimm-scale-4500` = **180px** | rounding, fine |
| Desktop right pad | 142px | `--zimm-scale-3500` = **140px** | 2px off |
| Mobile side pad | 30px (x=30) | `--zimm-scale-800` = **32px** | wrong token — `grid.containerPadding.base` is exactly `30px` |
| **Info column width** | **218px** | **`PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH = '360px'`** | **142px off** |

Desktop composition: 900 gallery + 179 gap + 218 info + 142 pad = 1439 ≈ 1440.
The code's `1fr 360px` yields a **760px gallery and a 360px info column** — gallery loses
140px, text column gains 142px. The author annotated the constant *"Provisional — no
matching zimm token; pending designer sign-off"*, so this was a known guess; we now have
the measured answer.

Mobile info column 342px at x=30 — matches `grid.containerPadding.base` exactly.
**All layout gaps are identical across breakpoints** (28/44/22/16/8/15/2); only width and
three icon sizes change.

### Design-side defects (all varying residuals — matching values matched at exactly 0px)
- `body2Strong` letter-spacing is **−0.12px** in the repo, **−0.14px** in Figma. The
  correct token **already exists**: `letterSpacings['2xs'] = '-0.00875rem' // -0.14px`
  (`typography.ts:27`). It is a mis-pointed token, not a missing one. **`typography.ts` is
  Tier 1** — UI Designer required.
- `#000000` hardcoded on two labels where everything else uses `text/default`.
- Product name uses a different style on mobile than desktop.
- **Mobile wishlist target is 20×20 — below the WCAG 2.2 AA 24×24 minimum.** (SFCC-434's
  ticket, but it should be known now, not at audit.)
- A layer named `Size & Fit` renders `Details & Care`.

### Resolves a standing repo open item
The button measures **50 / 5 / 24** on a CSS-comparable INSTANCE at **both** breakpoints —
confirming `button.ts`'s "provisional" `BTN_HEIGHT_LG` / `BTN_PADDING_Y` constants and
**contradicting `actionSizes` (52/32)**. `overrideStyling.md` lists this as an open gap; it
is now answerable.

### Trap — do not implement
The DS Typography collection is mode-switched (`body-2` = 14px desktop / 12px mobile), **but
neither frame switches modes** — both resolve to the same mode id, so rendered sizes are
identical. Do **not** build a responsive font-size step on the strength of the mode existing.

### Token gaps needing a designer decision (nothing invented)
Six off-scale spacing values — **6 / 15 / 22 / 28 / 43 / 44** — absent from the repo *and*
from the DS's own scale. Plus the undesigned tablet range and the 9px/13px chevrons.

---

## 5. Verification actually run (not assumed)

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npx tsc --noEmit` | **PASS**, no diagnostics |
| `npm run lint` | **FAIL** — 22 errors, **5 belong to this branch** (`breadcrumb/index.tsx:10`, `product-detail/index.tsx:16` and `:38`, `product-detail/index.stories.tsx:20` ×2 incl. `no-useless-escape`). All auto-fixable. **The PR body claims lint passes. It does not.** |
| `npx vitest run` | **PASS** — 146/146 across 4 files; this branch adds 5, all for `extractModelLine` |
| `npm run build` | **PASS** |
| `npm run test:max-file-size` | **PASS** — main 103.46 KB / 180 KB; vendor 524.74 KB / 550 KB (95.4% of budget) |
| `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` | **Script does not exist**, despite `overrideStyling.md` mandating it pre-PR. Pre-existing repo/doc gap |

**CI reality on the current head:** Vitest (146/146) and Storybook (27/27) genuinely
executed and passed. **But** two earlier runs on 2026-08-20 (`cf17c3d`, `d904c63`) are
recorded **green with every test job `skipped`** — the `detect-changes`
`since_last_remote_commit: true` trap. A skipped required check looks green and proves
nothing. **E2E is not a required check** — only `Storybook`, `Unit tests (Vitest)` and
`🔴 Branch Target Check` gate `develop`, so the entire red E2E suite does not block merge.
`🔴 Tier 1 — Frozen Files Check` reports "pass" but **did** flag `package.json` +
`package-lock.json` — that step only echoes a warning by design.

**Gated nowhere:** `eslint`, `prettier`, `tsc --noEmit`. Zero matches across all 15
workflows and none of the three husky hooks. **Storybook a11y IS gated** —
`.storybook/preview.tsx:34-36` sets `a11y.test: 'error'`, `@storybook/test-runner` reads it
directly, no `test-runner.js` exists or is needed, `qa.yml:262` invokes the binary.

**Side effect I caused and reverted:** `npm run build` runs `build-translations` first,
which regenerated 5 translation files (adding `header.button.assistive_msg.search`, a base
SFCC string — so the committed translations were already mildly stale). I reverted all
five; working tree is clean. Those files are Tier 2 (Integration/SI Partner).

---

## 6. Convention and structure findings

### Three premises that turned out wrong
1. **The component registry is NOT an unmerged dependency.** `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs`,
   `.claude/registry/*.md`, `.claude/hooks/registryUpdate.sh` are all on `develop`. It is
   fully automatic — components never register themselves; `scripts/hooks/pre-commit:49-62`
   regenerates and stages on every commit.
2. **The `ui-kits` convention is NOT settled.** `.claude/rules/uikit-components.md` exists
   only on the unmerged `origin/feature/f2r-implementation-workflow` branch and **directly
   contradicts `overrideStyling.md` on `develop`**: it *forbids* Chakra inside ui-kit files
   and mandates per-component `{name}.styles.ts` + Emotion `<Global>`, where
   `overrideStyling.md` mandates Chakra props + a theme recipe. The two never coexist on
   any branch. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` contains exactly **one** component
   (`atoms/zimmPageToolbar/`). No `molecules/`, no `organisms/`. Needs a ruling.
3. **None of the PDP-adjacent SFCC overrides exist** — `image-gallery`, `swatch-group`,
   `display-price`, `product-tile`, `product-item`, `recommended-products`, `product-view`,
   `quantity-picker`: zero files on HEAD *and* on `develop`. `overrideStyling.md` discusses
   several at length as if they exist; it is describing an aspiration.

### Three override intercept traps
- **(a) Storybook/Vitest resolver gap — real, confirmed, not currently triggered.**
  `.storybook/main.js:25` aliases `@salesforce/retail-react-app` straight to `node_modules`;

290	  sample: `Model is 5'10" Tall/177 cm and is wearing a US Size 6, runs true to size.`

303	```ts
304	/** Extracts the plain-text content of the first <li> starting with "Model is"
305	 *  from a sizeFit HTML string (SFCC c_sizeFit attribute). */
306	export function extractModelLine(html: string | undefined): string | undefined {
307	  if (!html) return undefined;
308	  const match = html.match(/<li>\s*(Model is[^<]*?)\s*<\/li>/i);
309	  return match?.[1]?.trim() || undefined;
310	}
311	```

# SFCC-89 — Requirements Picture

Research date: 2026-08-22 · Branch: `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-ui-static-product-information`
Method: Jira (issue + epic + links + subtasks + attachments), Confluence space SFCC, local `.docs/`,
plus a read-only cross-check against the code already on the branch.
**Nothing was modified. Read-only.**

---

## 1. One-paragraph summary

**SFCC-89 "PDP UI — Static Product Information"** (Story, High, 5 pts, **Sprint 3 (10–24 Aug 2026)**,
status **Code Review**, assignee **Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz**, reporter **Jasmijn Tsang**, due **2026-08-17**)
is the foundational PDP story: render the product fields that come straight off the SFCC product
record, with **no** dependency on Contentful, the colour/variation model, or inventory. Concretely
that is product name, single full price in the active storefront currency, product description,
optional "Model is…" copy (model height + size worn), style code, and a breadcrumb trail beneath the
product images reflecting the category path. The ticket's own description says it "is the most
foundational PDP story and should be built first." It is a **Level 2 page-level story** (parent epic
**SFCC-5 Product Detail Page (PDP)**), not a component build — which matters, because a **Level 1
component-epic story covering the same static fields now also exists (SFCC-737 `pdp/product-content`,
epic SFCC-2)**. Everything else on the PDP — badges, was/now price, swatches, size selector, CTAs,
gallery, accordions — is explicitly excluded and owned by named sibling tickets.

Fields **explicitly empty / not set**: `components` (none), `fixVersions` (none), `resolution` (none),
Story-point-estimate secondary field `customfield_10015` (null). Labels are set: `Custom`,
`DesignDependent`, `PRD-001`, `PRD-002`, `PRD-003`, `Squad-A`.

---

## 2. Acceptance criteria — verbatim, as a checklist

**Source: Jira field "Acceptance Criteria" (`customfield_10231`) on SFCC-89.** This field *is*
populated — it is not visible in the plain description, which is why it is easy to miss. Reproduced
verbatim below (original wiki markup flattened; wording unchanged).

> *Mandatory inputs for a Product to show on the website:*

**Product name**
- [ ] Given a shopper lands on a PDP, when the page loads, then the product name is displayed prominently at the top of the product information panel, sourced from the SFCC product record.

**Price**
- [ ] Given a shopper lands on a PDP and the product has a single full price, when the page loads, then the full price is displayed beneath the product name in the currency of the active storefront.

**Product description**
- [ ] Given a shopper lands on a PDP, when the page loads, then the product description is displayed.

**Product style code**
- [ ] Given a shopper lands on a PDP, when the page loads, then the product style code is displayed.

> *Optional input:*

**Model copy**
- [ ] Given a product has "Model is…" copy populated in the relevant SFCC attribute, when the page loads, then the model height and size worn are displayed on the page.
- [ ] Given a product does not have "Model is…" copy populated, when the page loads, then no model copy is displayed and no empty placeholder is shown.

---

**Breadcrumb navigation**
- [ ] Given a shopper is on a PDP, when the page loads, then a breadcrumb trail is displayed underneath the product pictures reflecting the product's category path (e.g. HOME / NEW / DRESSES / [PRODUCT NAME]).
- [ ] Given a shopper clicks a breadcrumb node, when the click is registered, then the shopper is navigated to the corresponding category page.

### Styling AC — held in two separate Jira Tasks, both still `To Do`

These are **not** subtasks of SFCC-89; they are standalone Tasks that name SFCC-89 in their body.
Both cite **Design ref: Figma node 5804-170721**.

**SFCC-732 — TC-001 — PDP Styling: Product Name Typography** (`Scope: Styling only`, precondition
1440px viewport):
- [ ] `.product-name` font-family = Futura Round
- [ ] `.product-name` font-size = 16px
- [ ] `.product-name` font-weight = 500
- [ ] `.product-name` line-height = 18px
- [ ] `.product-name` letter-spacing = -0.12px
- [ ] `.product-name` color = #191919
- [ ] `.product-name` text-transform = uppercase

**SFCC-733 — TC-002 — PDP Styling: Price Typography** (`Scope: Styling only`, precondition
"a PDP with a single full price" at 1440px):
- [ ] `.product-price` font-family = Futura Round
- [ ] `.product-price` font-size = 14px
- [ ] `.product-price` font-weight = 500
- [ ] `.product-price` line-height = 18px
- [ ] `.product-price` color = #191919

> Verified against the branch: the token values all line up. `heading3` = `fontSizes.xs` 16px /
> `fontWeights.medium` 500 / `lineHeights['2xs']` 18px / `letterSpacings.xs` -0.12px / uppercase, and
> `colour.ts` `text.default` = `grey[900]` = `#191919`. Price uses `--zimm-font-size-2xs` (14px),
> `--zimm-font-weight-medium`, `--zimm-font-lineheight-2xs` (18px), `text.default`.
> **The mismatch is the selector, not the value** — see Conflicts §6.5.

### Reference image (attachment)

One attachment: `image-20260716-035621.png` (482 KB, PNG, uploaded by Jasmijn Tsang 2026-07-16).
It is a **desktop PDP mock** — Zimmermann wordmark masthead over a full-bleed left-hand model shot,
right-hand info column showing (top to bottom): two tag pills (`RUNWAY`, `ANOTHER TAG`) with a
bookmark/wishlist icon at the right, product name `INDRA PLUNGE HALTER MAXI DRESS` in uppercase,
price `$1,100`, a short prose description, `Color: Raspberry` with two colour swatch thumbnails, a
`Size` dropdown with a `Find your size` link, a black full-width `ADD TO BAG` button, an underlined
`FIND IN BOUTIQUE` link, four `+` accordion rows (Details & Care / Size & Fit / Shipping & Returns /
Assistance), then `Model is 5'10" Tall/177cm and is wearing a US Size 6, runs true to size.` and
`Style Code: 7300JS261`.
**Important:** most of what the image shows is *out of scope* for SFCC-89. The description says
"Figma is leading". Only the name, price, description, model line and style code in that image belong
to this ticket. **No breadcrumb is visible in the attachment** — the crop ends above where it would sit.

---

## 3. IN SCOPE

From the description's own "In Scope" list (note: the list's **first bullet is literally empty** in
Jira — an authoring artifact, not a hidden requirement) plus the AC field:

1. **Product name** — from the SFCC product record, top of the product information panel.
2. **Full price** in the active storefront's currency — **single/full price only**.
3. **Product description**.
4. **"Model is…" copy** — model height and size worn. **Optional field**: must render nothing (not an
   empty placeholder) when unpopulated.
5. **Style Code**.
6. **Breadcrumb navigation** reflecting the product's category path, **at the bottom of the PDP /
   underneath the product pictures**, starting `HOME`, terminating in the product name, with each
   node navigating to its category page.

Implied-but-not-listed, and present in the branch's Gherkin (`e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-information.feature`):
loading skeletons, an error message when the product API fails, and graceful breadcrumb degradation
(Home-only) when the category API fails. **These are not in the Jira AC** — they are engineering
additions. Reasonable, but they are not a requirement anyone signed off; flagging so they aren't
mistaken for scope.

---

## 4. OUT OF SCOPE — and who owns it

Verbatim from SFCC-89's "Out of scope (separate stories)" list, mapped to the actual ticket:

| Excluded from SFCC-89 | Owning ticket | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Badges | **SFCC-132** PDP UI - Product Badges | **Blocked** |
| — badge merchandiser config | **SFCC-225** PDP – Product Badges — Merchandiser Configuration | Tech design |
| Was/Now sale price display | **SFCC-194** PDP – Was/Now Sale Price | Tech design |
| Wishlist icon (CTAs story) | **SFCC-434** PDP – Add to Wishlist | Tech design |
| — wishlist confirmation msg | **SFCC-710** PDP – Wishlist Confirmation Message on Add | To Do |
| Colour swatches & variation selection | **SFCC-91** PDP UI — Colour Swatches & Variation Selection | **In Progress** (same assignee) |
| — related colours attribute | **SFCC-708** PDP – Related Colours Attribute — BM / frontend | Tech design |
| Size selector & availability states | **SFCC-92** PDP — Size Selection & Add to Bag | **Blocked** |
| — product states (Coming Soon etc.) | **SFCC-150** PDP UI — Coming Soon, Back in Soon, Unavailable | **Blocked** |
| — buffer stock display | **SFCC-456** Buffer Stock – PDP Availability Display | To Do |
| Add to Bag CTA | **SFCC-92** | Blocked |
| Find in Boutique CTA | **SFCC-297** PDP UI — Find in Boutique Button and Slide-In Panel | Ready For Review |
| Image gallery | **SFCC-186** PDP – Product Image Gallery | Ready For Review |
| — gallery open/lightbox state | **SFCC-187** PDP – Image Gallery Open State | Tech design |
| — video in gallery | **SFCC-188** PDP – Product Video in Gallery | **Blocked** |
| Accordion — Details & Care | **SFCC-195** PDP – Slide Out - Details & Care | Tech design |
| Accordion — Size & Fit | **SFCC-102** PDP – Slide Out - Size & Fit | Ready For Review |
| Accordion — Shipping & Returns / Assistance | **SFCC-267** PDP – Slide Out – Shipping & Returns and Assistance | Ready For Review |
| Accordion — EU Environmental Qualities | **SFCC-266** PDP – Slide Out – EU Environmental Qualities | Ready For Review |
| Contentful-sourced content | (per-story; PDP has no Contentful story in this ticket) | — |

**Also out of scope, not named in SFCC-89's exclusion list but demonstrably owned elsewhere:**

- **Breadcrumb as a shared component** → **SFCC-578 SEO — Breadcrumb Component (PLP & PDP)**,
  epic **SFCC-22 SEO & Analytics & A/B Testing**, **Squad-B**, status **To Do**. See Conflicts §6.1.
- **BreadcrumbList structured data** → SFCC-573 (referenced by SFCC-578; depends on the component existing).
- Meta descriptions → SFCC-569 · hreflang → SFCC-564 · Product schema → SFCC-572 (all Squad-B, To Do).
- Measmerize / Find My Size → **SFCC-101** (Ready For Review).
- Max purchase qty → **SFCC-196** / **SFCC-268** / **SFCC-703**.
- Duties & taxes messaging → **SFCC-468**. Non-returnable badge → **SFCC-407**.
- Notify Me → **SFCC-149** / **SFCC-182** / **SFCC-183**.
- Gift card PDP → **SFCC-385** / **SFCC-386**.
- **PDP layout / hero composition** → **SFCC-723 `pdp/hero`** ("top-level orchestration component…
  composing `pdp/gallery` and `pdp/product-content` into a single responsive hero layout"). See §6.2.

---

## 5. Blockers and unresolved dependencies

### 5.1 Formal Jira links on SFCC-89

| Link | Ticket | Status | Blocking? |
|---|---|---|---|
| is blocked by | SFCC-205 Spike: Figma to React Setup | **Done** | No |
| is blocked by | SFCC-240 Spike: Figma-to-React Implementation Workflow | **Done** | No |
| is blocked by | **SFCC-26 Product Attributes – PDP** | **Ready to deploy to UAT** (Done category) | **Not Done in the environment** — see below |
| relates to | SFCC-132 PDP UI - Product Badges | **Blocked** | No (out of scope) |
| relates to | **SFCC-737 `pdp/product-content`** | Ready For Review | **Scope collision — see §6.2** |

**Subtasks:** SFCC-711 Test Case Creation — **Done**. SFCC-712 **Test Case Execution — To Do**.
SFCC-89 cannot honestly be called complete while SFCC-712 is unstarted.

### 5.2 SFCC-26 is "Ready to deploy to UAT", not deployed to the dev sandbox

SFCC-26 defines the product attribute schema SFCC-89 renders — including `name`, `shortDescription`,
`longDescription`, `styleNumber`, and critically **`modelFit`**. Its status sits in the *Done*
category but the status name is literally "Ready to **deploy** to UAT". Three E2E tests on the branch
are skipped with the note *"pending sandbox product provisioning"* (commit `4d7c129`), which is direct
evidence the attribute data is **not yet available in the environment SFCC-89 is being tested
against**. This is the single most material build blocker.

### 5.3 Design timing

Confluence **04.72 Component Design & User Story Tracker (id 408944644)** puts PDP at:
design components finalised **Aug 13 (Sprint 3)** · user stories ready for PO review **Aug 15** ·
**user stories ready for development Aug 24**. Today is **Aug 22**. SFCC-89 is already in Code Review,
i.e. **built ahead of its own "ready for development" date**. Confluence **04.7 Component Inventory
(id 400195591)** lists the PDP sub-component **"Product Content"** as **🟡 Done, minor update
required** — so the design SFCC-89 was built against is explicitly *not final*. 04.72 also states the
hard rule: *"Once a component is finalised and added to the UI kit, it is locked."* Product Content
is not yet locked.

### 5.4 Repo-level blockers introduced by the in-flight PR (governance, not requirements)

Cross-checked against `git diff develop...HEAD`:

- **`package.json` is modified** — adds `isomorphic-dompurify@^3.19.0` (+575 lines in
  `package-lock.json`). `package.json (root)` is **Tier 1 / frozen** (`.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md`)
  **and** AGENTS.md Hard Rule #7 forbids adding packages without integration-team approval. There is
  no evidence in the Jira ticket or its comments that this was approved. Must be resolved before merge.
- **`overrides/app/routes.tsx` is modified** — **Tier 2** Global Shell, owned by *both squads*
  (`protectedFiles.md`), requires a non-author review.
- **`overrides/app/theme/components/`** (new `pdpProductInfo.ts` + `index.ts` registration) — **Tier 2**,
  owner *UI Designer, notify before changing*.
- Touching Tier 1 and Tier 2 in one change trips **Hard Rule #10** (never touch more than one
  protection tier without confirming scope).

### 5.5 PR linkage

**Jira's development panel is empty** — no PRs, branches, or commits. The only pointer to the PR is a
comment: *"This card is already ready for review: https://github.com/ZimmermannAU/zimmermann-pwa/pull/57"*
(Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz, 2026-08-19). The Jira dev integration is configured for **Bitbucket**, but the
repo is on **GitHub** — so dev-panel traceability for this ticket does not work and shouldn't be relied on.

---

## 6. Conflicts between sources

> Project rule (AGENTS.md > Requirements): confirmed PRDs are the source of truth; conflicts must be
> surfaced, not silently resolved. Each of the following needs a human decision.

### 6.1 Breadcrumb ownership — SFCC-89 (Squad A) vs SFCC-578 (Squad B) — **highest risk**

SFCC-89 lists breadcrumb navigation as in-scope and has AC for it. **SFCC-578 "SEO — Breadcrumb
Component (PLP & PDP)"** is a *separate* story, in a *different epic* (SFCC-22 SEO & Analytics), owned
by a *different squad* (**Squad-B**), status **To Do**, describing the same component:
*"a breadcrumb navigation component displayed on PLP and PDP pages… BreadcrumbList schema (SFCC-573)
and heading hierarchy (SFCC-570) both depend on this component existing."*

The branch has already built `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx`. Per Confluence 04.72,
*"Each component is owned by the earliest epic in the sequence where it appears"* — which argues for
PDP owning it. But nobody has recorded that decision on either ticket, and SFCC-578 is still open and
unassigned. **Risk: Squad B builds a second breadcrumb, or SFCC-578 is closed without its SEO
requirements (BreadcrumbList schema, heading hierarchy) being met.** The current implementation emits
`<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` + `<ol>` + `aria-current="page"` but **no JSON-LD / BreadcrumbList
structured data** — correctly so, since that is SFCC-572/573, but it means SFCC-578 is not satisfied
by this work.

Also note the **placement wording differs**: SFCC-89 says breadcrumb at the **bottom of the PDP** /
"underneath the product pictures"; SFCC-578 and the PLP designs treat breadcrumbs as a top-of-page
wayfinding element ("HOME / COLLECTIONS / SWIM AND RESORT"). `.docs/prd/pdp.md` §1 (PRD-001) says only
*"Breadcrumb navigation displayed on all PDP pages"* — no position. The AC is the more specific source
and says beneath the pictures; the branch follows the AC. Worth confirming PLP won't diverge.

### 6.2 Two live tickets claim the same static fields — SFCC-89 vs SFCC-737

- **SFCC-89** — Level 2 **page** story, epic **SFCC-5 (PDP)**, Squad A, **Code Review**.
- **SFCC-737 `pdp/product-content`** — Level 1 **component** story, epic **SFCC-2 (PWA Kit
  Components)**, **Ready For Review**, and its description says it covers *"the static content
  elements (**product name, description, model description, style code**) that are not extracted into
  separate components."*

That is verbatim SFCC-89's scope. The two are linked only as a soft "relates to". Confluence **04.71
Writing User Stories for Components (id 400195600)** is explicit that this must not happen:
Level 2 page stories *"should not repeat the component build detail from Level 1. They are about the
interaction between components and the end-to-end experience on that page."* By that rule the
**component build belongs to SFCC-737**, and SFCC-89 should be the page-assembly story. The work on
this branch has been done as a component build under SFCC-89. Someone must decide which ticket the
`pdpProductInfo` component actually satisfies, and whether SFCC-737 is now a duplicate.

Related: **SFCC-723 `pdp/hero`** owns *"layout and composition only… composing `pdp/gallery` and
`pdp/product-content`"*. The branch's `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` implements a
two-column grid with a gallery placeholder `<Box>` and a `PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH = '360px'`
constant marked *"Provisional — no matching zimm token; pending designer sign-off"* — i.e. it is
doing `pdp/hero`'s job, with an unsigned-off magic value.

### 6.3 Model copy attribute — `modelFit` (spec) vs `c_sizeFit` (implementation) — **substantive**

This is a genuine requirements deviation, not a style nit.

**SFCC-26 (the blocking attribute story) defines two distinct attributes:**
- `modelFit` — *"This attribute is for displaying the model and sizing text **directly on the PDP**"* —
  sample: `Model is 5'10" Tall/177 cm and is wearing a US Size 6, runs true to size.`
- `sizeFit` — *"This attribute is for displaying the size and fit **on the Size & Fit tab**"* — which
  is **SFCC-102**, a different, out-of-scope story.

**The Jira comment history confirms `modelFit` was created deliberately for exactly this.**
Jasmijn Tsang, 2026-07-03: *"the model size and fit is now part of a overall 'size and fit' field in
Magento but in the new design we're taking the 'model' size and fit part to the PDP page — **that
requires a new product attribute which just contains that model size and fit part**. - To discuss with
Dani."* Then 2026-07-07: *"Informed them on product attribute needed for model size copy."*

**The branch does the opposite.** `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts` regex-scrapes the model line
out of the *Size & Fit* HTML:

```ts
/** Extracts the plain-text content of the first <li> starting with "Model is"
 *  from a sizeFit HTML string (SFCC c_sizeFit attribute). */
export function extractModelLine(html: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!html) return undefined;
  const match = html.match(/<li>\s*(Model is[^<]*?)\s*<\/li>/i);
  return match?.[1]?.trim() || undefined;
}
```

…and `product-detail/index.tsx` calls `extractModelLine((product as ProductWithSizeFit)?.c_sizeFit)`.

This is the pre-decision Magento behaviour the business explicitly moved away from. It is also brittle
(English-only `"Model is"` match, in an 11-locale storefront; breaks on any markup or copy variation)
and it silently couples SFCC-89 to SFCC-102's attribute. **Either `c_modelFit` is not yet provisioned
in the sandbox — which makes this a temporary workaround that must be flagged and removed — or the
requirement changed and nobody updated SFCC-26.** Must be confirmed with Jasmijn/Dani before sign-off.

### 6.4 Style code source — `product.id` vs `styleNumber`

SFCC-26 is precise: *"`ID` … can be the master product id / variant product id. **The master product
id, which is the stylecode, is displayed on the PDP**"* and *"`styleNumber` — This attribute is
**always** the master product id, whereas the product-id attribute can also contain the colour variant
or size variant ID."* The branch passes `styleCode={product?.id}`. On a master-product URL that is
correct; **once SFCC-91 (colour swatches, currently In Progress) starts routing to colour-variant IDs,
`product.id` will render a variant ID where the style code should be.** Sample values from SFCC-26:
`4673TS251` (style code) vs `4673TS251GVSCP0P` (variant). Low effort to fix now, latent bug if left.

### 6.5 Styling test cases assert CSS selectors the implementation does not expose

SFCC-732/733 assert on `.product-name` and `.product-price`. The component exposes neither — it uses
Chakra `__css` with `data-testid="product-price"` and no testid or class on the name element at all.
The *values* match (verified in §2), but both test cases will fail as written. Since SFCC-712 (Test
Case Execution) is still To Do, this will surface at QA. Needs a dev/QA agreement on the selector
contract.

### 6.6 `.docs/prd/pdp.md` vs Confluence 04.1.8 — two struck-through requirements

`.docs/prd/pdp.md` §13 documents **PRD-023 ("As Seen" editorial module)** and **PRD-025 (Styling
module)** as *"confirmed"*. Confluence **04.1.8 (id 302776322)** — which states it was extracted from
the functional-requirements workbook after all requirements were confirmed — shows **both rows struck
through, i.e. out of scope**: PRD-023 *"replaced by new ones designed (Shop the edit, Complete the
look, More from Category)"*; PRD-025 *"not having this anymore"*. The local PRD mirror is **stale**.
Does not affect SFCC-89 (both are out of scope either way) but the file is being treated as a source
of truth for other PDP stories and will mislead.

`.docs/prd/pdp.md` is **consistent** with SFCC-89 on everything in scope: §1 breadcrumb on all PDPs
(PRD-001) and style code (PRD-007); §2 name/price from Product API (PRD-002); §5 price in storefront
currency. No conflict found there.

### 6.7 `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md` is stale and contradicts Jira

The file is self-labelled *"Draft (2026-06-23)"* and says **"Current position: Sprint 0 — Foundation
(in progress)"**. It maps **Sprint 3 = 27 Jul – 7 Aug** with *"PDP (Part 2)"*. Jira's real
**SFCC Sprint 3 = 10 Aug – 24 Aug 2026** (active, board 500), which is where SFCC-89 actually sits.
Per AGENTS.md Hard Rule #14 this file is supposed to be checked before scoping new work — as written
it would give the wrong sprint and the wrong "what exists yet" picture. Do not rely on it.

`.docs/memory/projectState.md` contains **no SFCC-89, PDP-build, or breadcrumb entry at all** — only
three passing mentions of PDP in forward-looking lists. There is no local record of this work.

---

## 7. Open questions a human must answer before SFCC-89 can be called complete

Ordered by how much they can invalidate the build.

1. **Model copy attribute (§6.3).** Is `c_modelFit` provisioned? Should the code read `c_modelFit`
   directly instead of regex-scraping `c_sizeFit`? If `c_sizeFit` scraping is a deliberate interim
   workaround, whose ticket removes it, and is SFCC-26 wrong? → **Jasmijn Tsang / Dani Rivett.**
2. **SFCC-89 vs SFCC-737 (§6.2).** Which ticket owns the `pdpProductInfo` component build? Is SFCC-737
   now a duplicate to be closed, or does SFCC-89 need re-scoping to page assembly per Confluence 04.71?
   Same question for the hero-layout code sitting in `product-detail/index.tsx` vs **SFCC-723**.
3. **Breadcrumb ownership (§6.1).** Does the breadcrumb component built here close **SFCC-578**
   (Squad-B), or does Squad B still build its own? If it closes it, who adds the SEO obligations
   (BreadcrumbList schema SFCC-573, heading hierarchy SFCC-570) and when? Confirm the breadcrumb
   position (bottom, per AC) is also right for PLP.
4. **`package.json` / `isomorphic-dompurify` (§5.4).** Was this dependency approved by the integration
   team? It is a Tier 1 + Hard Rule #7 change with no approval recorded on the ticket. Also confirm
   the multi-tier scope (Tier 1 + two Tier 2 areas) is accepted — Hard Rule #10.
5. **Sandbox data (§5.2).** When will SFCC-26's attributes be provisioned in the environment SFCC-89
   is tested against, so the three skipped E2E tests can be unskipped? Without this the AC is unproven.
6. **Design lock (§5.3).** Confluence 04.7 has PDP "Product Content" as *Done, minor update required*

195	Existing precedent to copy verbatim — `pdpProductInfo` **[V]**:
196	- Component consumes the recipe via `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmPdpProductInfo', {})` and applies parts
197	  as `__css={styles.<part>}` (`pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:27, 32`).
198	- Recipe declares `parts: ['name','price','description','modelInfo','styleCode']` and a `baseStyle`
199	  per part (`theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts:56-90`).
200	- Values that genuinely can't live in `baseStyle` (conditional margins) are exported as named consts
201	  from the theme file and imported by the component — `SPACE_DESCRIPTION_TO_META`,
202	  `SPACE_MODEL_INFO_TO_STYLE_CODE` (`pdpProductInfo.ts:47,50` → `index.tsx:4,42,53`). That is the
203	  house pattern for "styling that must be at the call site": **name it in the theme file anyway.**

208	`borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles, components`. `fontSizes`, `sizes`, and
209	`transition` are **deliberately not registered** because Zimmermann and Chakra use the same key names
210	for different values (`theme/index.ts:26-49`). So `fontSize="2xs"` in a recipe silently resolves to

212	`fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-2xs)'`. `spacing` **is** registered as `space`, so `marginBottom: 'l'`

278	`display-price` (`product-view:53` + 5 others), `quantity-picker` (`product-view:50`),
279	`breadcrumb` (**already overridden**, and `product-view/index.jsx:45` imports it by base path — so the
280	moment anything writes a story or test that renders base `ProductView`, it will render the *base*
281	breadcrumb, not ours). **[V]**
282	
283	Rule for new PDP code, per `overrideStyling.md` > "Importing an already-overridden component":
284	import an already-overridden sibling by **relative path** (`'../breadcrumb'`), never by base path. The
285	PDP page already does this correctly at `index.tsx:6,8,9` (all relative `../../components/…`). **[V]**
286	
287	### (b) `shared/ui` barrel — a relative re-export the resolver never rewrites
288	
289	**Confirmed with hard numbers [V]:**
290	- `node_modules/…/app/components/shared/ui/index.jsx` is a pure barrel of **103** relative re-exports
291	  (`export {Box} from './Box'`, `export {Button} from './Button'`, …).
292	- Base files importing the barrel path `…/components/shared/ui'`: **212**.
293	- Base files importing a deep `…/components/shared/ui/<Name>` path: **0**.
294	
295	Because the re-export is relative (`'./Button'`), the `ccExtensibility` resolver — which only rewrites
296	`@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` specifiers — never sees it. Creating
297	`overrides/app/components/shared/ui/Button/index.tsx` would intercept **zero** of those 212 consumers.
298	You would additionally have to override the barrel itself.
299	
300	**Does the PDP work depend on this? No, and it should not start.** The sub-modules are one-line Chakra
301	re-exports (`shared/ui/Skeleton/index.jsx` is literally `export {Skeleton} from '@chakra-ui/react'`) —
302	there is nothing to override there. No `overrides/app/components/shared/` exists on HEAD or `develop`
303	(`git ls-tree` = 0 on both). The correct lever for `Box`/`Text`/`Skeleton` styling is the Chakra theme,
304	which is already how the repo does it. **[V]**
305	
306	Style consistency note: `breadcrumb/index.tsx:3` imports `Box, Text` from `@chakra-ui/react` directly
307	while `product-detail/index.tsx:5` and `zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:3` import them from the SFCC
308	`shared/ui` barrel. Functionally identical (the barrel is a Chakra re-export), but pick one for new
309	files. **[V]**
310	
311	### (c) conditional render of an alternate module
312	
313	**The `_app` checkout swap is real but does not touch PDP [V]:**
314	`node_modules/…/app/components/_app/index.jsx:216` computes `const isCheckout = /\/checkout$/.test(location?.pathname)`,
315	then `:403` swaps `Header` → `CheckoutHeader` and `:484` `{!isCheckout ? <Footer /> : <CheckoutFooter />}`.
316	`/product/:productId` never matches that regex, so PDP always gets the normal Header/Footer.
317	**No PDP equivalent of this trap exists.** **[V]**
318	
319	**Two adjacent things worth knowing anyway [V]:**
320	1. **`<Island hydrateOn='visible'>`.** Base wraps `ProductView`, `InformationAccordion`, and all three
321	   `RecommendedProducts` in `<Island>` (`product-detail/index.jsx:674, 788, 816, 831, 846`) — deferred
322	   hydration. Our override uses no Island. If PDP work reintroduces base components, they will hydrate
323	   eagerly unless Island is reintroduced too. Relevant to the ≤2s p75 mobile LCP budget in AGENTS.md.
324	2. **Set/bundle branch.** `product-detail/index.jsx:672` renders a structurally different tree for
325	   `isProductASet || isProductABundle` (per-child `ProductView` + `InformationAccordion`). Our override
326	   renders one shape for every product type, so a set or bundle SKU will render as a plain product. Not
327	   an override-bypass — a functional gap. **[V]**
328	3. `ProductView` is rendered from 6 places, not just PDP (`product-view-modal/index.jsx`,
329	   `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx`, + tests). An override of it
330	   is a Tier-2-scale blast radius, not a PDP-local change. **[V]**
331	
332	---
333	
334	## 5. Data layer
335	
336	**Rule** (`.claude/rules/components.md` > Composition): anything under `overrides/app/components/`
337	receives data as props and calls **no** data-fetching hook — not `useProduct`, not any
338	`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` / React Query hook. Fetching lives in `overrides/app/pages/`. **[V]**
339	
340	**The PDP obeys this today** — `useProduct`/`useCategory` are called only in
341	`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:21-31`; `PdpProductInfo`, `Breadcrumb` and
342	`ZimmPageToolbar` are all pure prop-driven. **[V]**
343	
344	**Type chain [V]:**
345	
346	```
347	useProduct  →  node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/hooks/ShopperProducts/query.d.ts:28
348	               UseQueryResult<DataType<Client['getProduct']>>
349	            →  commerce-sdk-isomorphic ShopperProductsModelTypes.Product
350	               (node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.esm.d.ts:59783-59835)
351	```
352	
353	Fields the PDP already reads, all optional on the type: `id: string` (the only required one), `name?`,
354	`price?`, `currency?`, `shortDescription?`, `longDescription?`, `primaryCategoryId?`. Also available and
355	unused: `imageGroups?: Array<ImageGroup>`, `variants?`, `variationAttributes?`, `variationValues?`,
356	`master?`, `inventory?`/`inventories?`, `type?: ProductType`, `setProducts?`, `bundledProducts?`,
357	`productPromotions?`, `priceRanges?`, `prices?`, `pageMetaTags?`, `slugUrl?`. **[V]**
358	
359	**Custom SFCC attributes.** The type ends in `& { [key: string]: any }` (`index.esm.d.ts:59834`), so any
360	`c_*` attribute typechecks as `any` for free. The repo deliberately does **not** rely on that — it
361	declares a narrowed intersection type instead:
362	
363	```ts
364	// overrides/app/types/commerce.ts:7-10
365	export type ProductWithSizeFit = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useProduct>['data']> & {
366	  c_sizeFit?: string;
367	};
368	```
369	
370	Used at `product-detail/index.tsx:78` as `(product as ProductWithSizeFit | undefined)?.c_sizeFit`.
371	**Copy this pattern for every new `c_*` attribute** — add the field to `commerce.ts`, re-export from
372	`types/index.ts`. It satisfies AGENTS.md > Type Definitions ("don't re-declare types already exported by
373	`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`") by deriving from `ReturnType<typeof useProduct>` rather than restating it. **[V]**
374	
375	**Category shape:** `useCategory(...).data.parentCategoryTree` → `Array<PathRecord>` where
376	`PathRecord = {id?: string; name?: string}` (`index.esm.d.ts:~59860`). The PDP narrows it to a local
377	`BreadcrumbCategory {id: string; name: string}` with a type predicate at `index.tsx:38-40`. **[V]**
378	
379	**Mocking policy.** AGENTS.md > Rules: no MSW / hardcoded fixtures in **production paths**. Stories and
380	tests are not production paths — `index.stories.tsx:4` imports
381	`mockStandardProductOrderable` from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/mocks/standard-product` and that is
382	compliant. **[V]**
383	
384	---
385	
386	## 6. Test requirements & what CI actually enforces
387	
388	### 6a. Storybook a11y — gated. Confirmed still true.
389	
390	- `.storybook/preview.tsx:34-50` sets `parameters.a11y.test = 'error'`, with an inline comment:
391	  "'error' causes a11y violations to fail `test-storybook --ci` runs". It also excludes the six Chakra
392	  toast-manager `role="region"` containers from all a11y checks. **[V]**
393	- `.storybook/` contains exactly two files: `main.js`, `preview.tsx`. **There is no
394	  `.storybook/test-runner.js`, and none is needed** — `@storybook/test-runner` v0.24 reads
395	  `parameters.a11y.test` from `preview.tsx` directly. **[V]**
396	- `@storybook/test-runner ^0.24.4` and `@storybook/addon-a11y ^10.4.6` are devDependencies;
397	  the addon is registered at `.storybook/main.js:10`. **[V]**
398	- `.github/workflows/qa.yml:236-272` job `storybook-test`: builds Storybook, serves `storybook-static`
399	  on `:6006` via `http-server`, then `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook --ci --url http://127.0.0.1:6006`.
400	  Note it invokes the binary directly — **there is no `test-storybook` npm script** in `package.json`,
401	  so locally you must run `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook` yourself. **[V]**
402	
403	### 6b. What `qa.yml` gates (PRs to `develop` and `release/**` only)
404	
405	| Job | Gated? | Condition |
406	|---|---|---|
407	| `unit-tests` (Vitest, `npm test`) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:207-227`; runs if any `overrides/**`, `vitest.config.*`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `babel.config.js` changed, or `package.json` `dependencies` changed |
408	| `storybook-test` (play + a11y) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:236-272`; runs if `overrides/app/{components,pages,hooks,theme,types}/**`, `.storybook/**`, or `package*.json` changed |
409	| `e2e-localhost` (Playwright, real SFCC dev org) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:280-409` |
410	| `e2e-browserstack` | Conditional | `qa.yml:427-473`; `release/**` → full suite; `develop` PR → only if an `SFCC-\d+` key appears in PR title/body/branch, `--grep`-scoped to it |
411	| **ESLint** | **NO** | `grep -rnE 'eslint\|npm run lint' .github/workflows/` → **zero matches across all 15 workflow files** **[V]** |
412	| **Prettier / `npm run format`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. Only local: `.claude/settings.json` PostToolUse `Write` runs `prettier --write` on newly-written files **[V]** |
413	| **`tsc --noEmit`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. It is an AGENTS.md hard requirement enforced by nobody but you **[V]** |
414	
415	Git hooks in `.husky/` are `commit-msg` (conventional commits), `pre-commit` (registry regen + Contentful
416	drift + derived-AI-config protection + `.env.sample` secret guard), `pre-push` (tag-name validation).
417	**None of the three runs lint, prettier, or tsc.** **[V]**
418	
419	### 6c. E2E scoping — a PDP change runs the FULL suite
420	
421	`qa.yml:97-102` defines exactly one area allow-list, `e2e_homepage`. There is **no `e2e_pdp` group**,
422	even though 11 specs already carry `@pdp`. `qa.yml:135-146` narrows to an area only when *every*
423	e2e-relevant changed file falls inside that one area's list — a PDP file never does, so `e2e_scope`
424	falls back to `full`. That is the deliberate fail-safe direction (more tests, not fewer), not a bug —
425	but it means every PDP PR pays for the whole Playwright suite. Adding an `e2e_pdp` group is a cheap,
426	self-contained follow-up. **[V]**
427	
428	### 6d. What a new PDP component is actually required to have
429	
430	Per `.claude/rules/testing.md` and `.claude/rules/components.md` > Storybook **[V]**:
431	
432	| Layer | Required? |
433	|---|---|
434	| `*.stories.tsx` | **Yes, always**, for anything exported from its folder under `components/` or `pages/`. Not required for a sub-component that only ever renders inside one parent. Needs a `Default` export; named exports for meaningful states only. |
435	| `play` fn inside the story | Only when there is interactive behaviour worth asserting (validation on blur, disclosure open/close, focus movement, controlled-input wiring). Purely visual stories need none. Query via `within(canvasElement)`, `getByRole` first. Import `userEvent`/`expect` from the Storybook re-export — `pdpProductInfo/index.stories.tsx:2` uses `from 'storybook/test'`. |
436	| `*.test.ts` (Vitest) | Only when failure would be non-obvious or costly: data mapping, integration boundaries, complex state, pure logic that survives a refactor invisibly. Explicitly **not** for re-exports, one-liners, or framework behaviour. `extractModelLine` is the canonical example of a "yes". |
437	| `.feature` + Playwright spec | For a new user journey. Gherkin first, **Lead QA signs off the `.feature` before any Playwright is written** (`.claude/skills/qa-generate/`). Tag every `test()` with both `@<area>` and `@SFCC-NNN`. |
438	
439	Storybook category for PDP components: **`Commerce/`** (`components.md` > Categorisation — "Commerce-specific
440	shared components"). `Pages/` for the full page assembly. Titles in use today are all consistent with
441	the rules table **[V]**: `Commerce/PdpProductInfo`, `Pages/PDP`, `Layout/Breadcrumb`,
442	`Layout/PageToolbar`, `Elements/Button`. Note `zimmPageToolbar`'s story title is `Layout/PageToolbar`
443	(no `Zimm` prefix) while the component and folder are `ZimmPageToolbar`/`zimmPageToolbar` — follow the
444	same shape for new ui-kit components.
445	
446	Accessibility rules are **mechanically enforced** by `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/` at PR review:
447	`<img>` needs `alt`, `IconButton` needs `aria-label`, non-interactive element with `onClick` needs
448	`role` (+ `tabIndex={0}` + `onKeyDown`). `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` must wrap its value in a sanitizer —
449	enforced by `semgrep.yml`. `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:43,54` already does this with
450	`DOMPurify.sanitize(...)` from `isomorphic-dompurify`. **[V]**
451	
452	---
453	
454	## 7. REUSE OPPORTUNITIES
455	
456	Things a PDP build should be using rather than rebuilding:
457	
458	1. **`PdpProductInfo` + its theme recipe** — `overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` and
459	   `overrides/app/theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`. Name / price / sanitized description / model
460	   line / style code, all test-id'd, all styled through `useMultiStyleConfig`. **This is the reference
461	   implementation of the repo's styling convention** — copy its structure for every new PDP component.
462	2. **`Breadcrumb`** — `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx`. Wired to live `useCategory`
463	   data, `aria-label="Breadcrumb"`, `aria-current="page"` on the terminal crumb, `aria-hidden`
464	   separators, exports its own `BreadcrumbCategory` type. Import it **relatively**.
465	3. **`ZimmPageToolbar`** — `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx`. Already has `recently-viewed`
466	   and `section-title` variants built and **unused**. A "You May Also Like" / "Recently Viewed" PDP
467	   section should use `variant="recently-viewed"` rather than a new wrapper.
468	4. **`extractModelLine`** — `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts`, plus its 5 passing tests.
469	5. **`ProductWithSizeFit`** — `overrides/app/types/commerce.ts`. Extend this file for new `c_*` fields;
470	   don't re-derive the Product type per component.
471	6. **`PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH`** — exported from `product-detail/index.tsx:14` and already consumed by
472	   the story. Any gallery/options layout work should import it, not restate `360px`.
473	7. **`ProductPage` POM** — `e2e/support/pages/ProductPage.js`. Already has `goToProduct()` with the 20s
474	   SFCC-API gate, `selectVariant()`, `addToCart()`, `getFirstBreadcrumbCategoryLink()`, and locators for
475	   `product-price` / `product-description` / `product-style-code` / `product-model-info` /
476	   `sale-price` / `original-price` / `out-of-stock` / `cart-drawer`. **`sale-price`, `original-price`,
477	   `out-of-stock` and `cart-drawer` locators exist but nothing renders those test-ids yet** — they are a
478	   pre-agreed contract for the next PDP slice. Use those exact test-ids.
479	8. **SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches`** — 189 lines of component + 256 lines of Vitest + 204 lines of
480	   stories + an 883-line spec at `.docs/specs/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.md`, plus the multi-colour
481	   SKU fixture in `e2e/fixtures/products.js`. **Rebase-and-adopt, do not rewrite.** Two caveats: it
482	   predates the `pdpProductInfo` theme-recipe refactor (rebase conflict guaranteed in
483	   `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx`), and it needs relocating to `ui-kits/` + a theme recipe to match convention.
484	9. **`.claude/rules/overrides.md`** on `origin/feature/f2r-component-registry` — the pre-flight checklist
485	   (default export, internal-consumer grep, `forwardRef`, Chakra deep-merge audit, prop-superset pattern,
486	   `vendor.d.ts` ambient rule). If PDP work overrides any SFCC component, run that checklist. Consider
487	   asking for it to be merged to `develop`, since `overrideStyling.md` already links to it and the link
488	   is currently dead.
489	10. **`overrides/app/utils/sfccImage.ts` — `proxyImageUrl(url)`.** **This one matters a lot for the
490	    gallery.** It rewrites an absolute SFCC static-asset URL to `/mobify/proxy/<path>…` by matching the
491	    hostname against `getConfig().ssrParameters.proxyConfigs`. Its JSDoc states the reason: direct
492	    browser access to the Demandware host "is typically blocked by Cloudflare WAF outside of the
493	    Commerce Cloud network." Any code that renders `product.imageGroups[].images[].link` **must** pass
494	    it through this helper or images will 403 for real shoppers. It fails open (returns the URL
495	    unchanged) on a relative or malformed URL. **[V]**
496	
497	### Gaps the takeover should decide about explicitly
498	
499	- **The gallery column is a coloured empty box** (`index.tsx:56`). Everything image-related is unbuilt.
500	- **`overrideStyling.md` vs `uikit-components.md`** — two mutually exclusive styling models on two
501	  branches (§2c). Get a ruling before writing components.
502	- **`ui-kits/` has one component and no rules doc on `develop`** (§2b/2c). Both `pdpProductInfo` and
503	  SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches` sit outside it. Either relocate them or stop calling ui-kits settled.
504	- **The story duplicates the page shell** (`index.stories.tsx:43-65` vs `index.tsx:48-88`) because
505	  Storybook has no `CommerceApiProvider`. Adding one to `.storybook/preview.tsx` would delete the
506	  duplication — but `.storybook/` is **Tier 1 frozen** (`frozenFiles.md` > Test & Tooling Config), so
507	  that needs Integration/SI Partner approval.
508	- **Error handling diverges from base**: base throws `HTTPNotFound`/`HTTPError` (`index.jsx:194-209`),
509	  ours renders an inline message (`index.tsx:66`). SEO consequence — a bad `productId` returns HTTP 200
510	  with an error string instead of a 404. AGENTS.md calls SEO a top requirement; worth raising.
511	- **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` is Squad A territory** (`.claude/rules/squadA.md:5`, draft),
512	  and the shared product components (`product-tile/`, `display-price/`, `image-gallery/`,
513	  `swatch-group/`, `recommended-products/`, `product-item/`) are **Tier 2, owned by Squad B**
514	  (`protectedFiles.md` > Shared Product Components). Overriding any of them crosses a squad boundary
515	  and needs Squad B notification; AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10 also requires stopping to confirm scope
516	  before touching more than one protection tier in a change.

# PDP integration surface — codebase map

Branch surveyed: `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-ui-static-product-information` @ `d526ad1`, clean tree,
24 commits ahead of `develop` (`cd68e97`). `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 on this branch (verified).

Legend: **[V]** verified by reading the file/running the command · **[I]** inferred.

---

## 1. PDP surface that already exists

### 1a. The page

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — 95 lines. **It is a full replacement of the base
page, not a decoration of it.** It renders only: a grey placeholder box where the gallery goes, a
`PdpProductInfo` block, and a breadcrumb toolbar underneath. **[V]**

| Line | What |
|---|---|
| `index.tsx:14` | `export const PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH = '360px'` — provisional, commented as pending designer sign-off |
| `index.tsx:21-25` | `useProduct({parameters:{id: productId}}, {enabled: Boolean(productId)})` |
| `index.tsx:28-31` | `useCategory({parameters:{id: product?.primaryCategoryId ?? null, levels:1}})`, gated on the product having loaded |
| `index.tsx:35-40` | Builds breadcrumb path from `category.parentCategoryTree`, degrades to `[]` on category error |
| `index.tsx:42-45` | `intl.formatNumber(product.price, {style:'currency', currency: product.currency})` |
| `index.tsx:56` | **Gallery column is an empty `<Box>` placeholder** — `aspectRatio={{base:'3/4', md:'49/60'}}`, `backgroundColor="background.02"`. Comment: "images out of scope, placeholder maintains layout" |
| `index.tsx:65-81` | error / isLoading / loaded three-way branch |
| `index.tsx:85-87` | `<ZimmPageToolbar variant="breadcrumbs"><Breadcrumb …/></ZimmPageToolbar>` |
| `index.tsx:92` | `ProductDetail.getTemplateName = () => 'product-detail'` |

Route wiring: `overrides/app/routes.tsx:25` (`loadable(() => import('./pages/product-detail'))`)
and `:38-40` place `/product/:productId` **before** `..._routes` (`:41`), so the override wins by
route order regardless of the module resolver. **[V]**

### 1b. What the base has that we have *not* carried over

Base is `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx` — 876 lines
vs our 95. Everything below is present in base and **absent** from the override **[V]**:

| Base capability | Base ref | Status in override |
|---|---|---|
| `ProductView` (gallery, swatches, qty, add-to-bag) | `index.jsx:41, 675/707/789` | absent |
| `RecommendedProducts` ×3 zones (Einstein) | `index.jsx:40, 817/832/847` | absent |
| `InformationAccordion` (`partials/information-accordion.jsx`) | `index.jsx:42, 776/808` | absent |
| `<Island hydrateOn='visible'>` deferred hydration wrappers | `index.jsx:674, 788, 816…` | absent |
| `<Helmet>` SEO block | `index.jsx:658-669` | absent |
| `HTTPNotFound` / `HTTPError` throw on 404/5xx | `index.jsx:194-209` | **absent — we render an inline `<Text>` instead (`index.tsx:66`)** |
| `res.set('Cache-Control', …)` SSR cache headers | `index.jsx:86-87` | absent |
| Rich `useProduct` params: `perPricebook`, `allImages`, `expand:[availability, promotions, options, images, prices, variations, set_products, bundled_products, page_meta_tags]`, `inventoryIds`, `keepPreviousData` | `index.jsx:110-136` | **absent — our call requests `id` only** |
| Set / bundle branch (`isProductASet`, `isProductABundle`) | `index.jsx:155-156, 672` | absent |
| `useProductInventory`, `useVariant`, `useCurrentBasket`, wishlist, toast, Einstein/DataCloud/ActiveData | `index.jsx:70-240` | absent |

> Note on `allImages: true` — memory file `project_sfcc29_product_display_outage.md` records this
> flag as implicated in a backend product-display outage. Re-check before adding it back.

### 1c. PDP-adjacent components — override + recipe status

`ls overrides/app/components/` on this branch: `_app-config breadcrumb button contentful foundation
header icons pageContainer pdpProductInfo ui-kits` — **that is the whole list.** **[V]**

| Component | Override exists? | Theme recipe in `theme/components/`? | Base consumers if you override it later |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image-gallery` | **No** (also not on `develop` — `git ls-tree` = 0) | No | 2: `product-view`, `product-view-modal/bundle` |
| `swatch-group` | **No** | No | 2: `product-tile`, `product-view` |
| `display-price` | **No** | No | **6**: `product-tile`, `item-variant/item-price`, `product-view`, `use-add-to-cart-modal`, 2× checkout cards |
| `product-tile` | **No** | No | 2: `product-scroller`, `pages/product-list` |
| `product-item` | **No** | No | 3 |
| `recommended-products` | **No** | No | 5 |
| `product-view` | **No** | No | **6** incl. `product-view-modal`, `bonus-product-view-modal` |
| `quantity-picker` | **No** | No | 2: `product-view`, `product-item/product-quantity-picker` |
| `breadcrumb` | **Yes** — `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx` (86 ln) | No (styles inline in the file) | 1 base consumer: `product-view/index.jsx:45` |
| `pdpProductInfo` (Zimmermann-only) | **Yes** — 69 ln | **Yes** — `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`, registered `theme/components/index.ts:4,10` as `ZimmPdpProductInfo` | n/a |
| `zimmPageToolbar` (Zimmermann-only) | **Yes** — `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx` (73 ln) | **No** — styling is a `PADDING` const at `index.tsx:28-33` | n/a |

**Important correction to a common assumption:** `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` talks at length

### 2e. Concrete path example — a new PDP component per the rules as written

For a hypothetical `PdpSizeSelector`:

```

  index.stories.tsx    ← title: 'Commerce/PdpSizeSelector'  (commerce-aware → Commerce/, per components.md)
  index.test.ts        ← only if logic-heavy
overrides/app/theme/components/pdpSizeSelector.ts   ← exports `ZimmPdpSizeSelector` (parts + baseStyle)
overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts             ← add import + key to the `components` object
```

Existing precedent to copy verbatim — `pdpProductInfo` **[V]**:
- Component consumes the recipe via `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmPdpProductInfo', {})` and applies parts
  as `__css={styles.<part>}` (`pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:27, 32`).
- Recipe declares `parts: ['name','price','description','modelInfo','styleCode']` and a `baseStyle`
  per part (`theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts:56-90`).
- Values that genuinely can't live in `baseStyle` (conditional margins) are exported as named consts
  from the theme file and imported by the component — `SPACE_DESCRIPTION_TO_META`,
  `SPACE_MODEL_INFO_TO_STYLE_CODE` (`pdpProductInfo.ts:47,50` → `index.tsx:4,42,53`). That is the
  house pattern for "styling that must be at the call site": **name it in the theme file anyway.**
- The theme file carries a header comment explaining each level-4 (`var(--zimm-*)`) escape and why
  no `textStyle` exists for it yet (`pdpProductInfo.ts:1-33`).

**Chakra scale caveat (matters for any new recipe):** `theme/index.ts:51-58` registers only
`borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles, components`. `fontSizes`, `sizes`, and
`transition` are **deliberately not registered** because Zimmermann and Chakra use the same key names
for different values (`theme/index.ts:26-49`). So `fontSize="2xs"` in a recipe silently resolves to
Chakra's 10px, not Zimmermann's 14px — which is exactly why `pdpProductInfo.ts` uses
`fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-2xs)'`. `spacing` **is** registered as `space`, so `marginBottom: 'l'`
is safe. **[V]**

## 4. Intercept traps — which apply

### (a) base-path import → unstyled base component in Storybook & Vitest

**Mechanism confirmed [V]:**
- `package.json` `ccExtensibility: {extends: '@salesforce/retail-react-app', overridesDir: 'overrides'}`
  — read by the pwa-kit webpack plugin, i.e. **real builds only**.
- `.storybook/main.js:25` aliases `'@salesforce/retail-react-app'` → `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app`,
  bypassing the resolver entirely.
- `vitest.config.ts:17-20` aliases only `~` and `app` — it never mentions
  `@salesforce/retail-react-app`, so those imports go straight to `node_modules` by normal resolution.

**Does it apply to the PDP work today? Not yet.** I cross-referenced every base-path import in
`overrides/` against every existing override directory. The **only** collision in the entire repo is
`icons`, and it is deliberate (`overrides/app/components/icons/index.tsx:73` re-exports from the base
icon set — that's the documented single-source-of-truth pattern; `header/index.tsx:44` imports the
same base path). **[V]**

Every other base-path import in `overrides/` resolves to a module we do **not** override
(`shared/ui`, `constants`, `contexts`, `utils/*`, `seo`, `link`, `loading-spinner`, `search`,
`with-registration`, `product-scroller`, `section`, `hooks/use-multi-site`, `hooks/use-current-basket`,
`hooks/use-navigation`, `hooks/use-einstein`, `app/theme`, `app/routes`, `app/mocks/standard-product`).
Per `overrideStyling.md` that is simply correct. **[V]**

**It becomes live the moment PDP work adds an override.** Concretely: if you create
`overrides/app/components/swatch-group/`, then `product-view/index.jsx:55` imports it by base path —
correct in the app, base-unstyled in Storybook/Vitest. Same for `image-gallery` (`product-view:44,48`),
`display-price` (`product-view:53` + 5 others), `quantity-picker` (`product-view:50`),
`breadcrumb` (**already overridden**, and `product-view/index.jsx:45` imports it by base path — so the
moment anything writes a story or test that renders base `ProductView`, it will render the *base*
breadcrumb, not ours). **[V]**

Rule for new PDP code, per `overrideStyling.md` > "Importing an already-overridden component":
import an already-overridden sibling by **relative path** (`'../breadcrumb'`), never by base path. The
PDP page already does this correctly at `index.tsx:6,8,9` (all relative `../../components/…`). **[V]**

### (b) `shared/ui` barrel — a relative re-export the resolver never rewrites

**Confirmed with hard numbers [V]:**
- `node_modules/…/app/components/shared/ui/index.jsx` is a pure barrel of **103** relative re-exports
  (`export {Box} from './Box'`, `export {Button} from './Button'`, …).
- Base files importing the barrel path `…/components/shared/ui'`: **212**.
- Base files importing a deep `…/components/shared/ui/<Name>` path: **0**.

Because the re-export is relative (`'./Button'`), the `ccExtensibility` resolver — which only rewrites
`@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` specifiers — never sees it. Creating
`overrides/app/components/shared/ui/Button/index.tsx` would intercept **zero** of those 212 consumers.
You would additionally have to override the barrel itself.

**Does the PDP work depend on this? No, and it should not start.** The sub-modules are one-line Chakra
re-exports (`shared/ui/Skeleton/index.jsx` is literally `export {Skeleton} from '@chakra-ui/react'`) —
there is nothing to override there. No `overrides/app/components/shared/` exists on HEAD or `develop`
(`git ls-tree` = 0 on both). The correct lever for `Box`/`Text`/`Skeleton` styling is the Chakra theme,
which is already how the repo does it. **[V]**

Style consistency note: `breadcrumb/index.tsx:3` imports `Box, Text` from `@chakra-ui/react` directly
while `product-detail/index.tsx:5` and `zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:3` import them from the SFCC
`shared/ui` barrel. Functionally identical (the barrel is a Chakra re-export), but pick one for new
files. **[V]**

### (c) conditional render of an alternate module

**The `_app` checkout swap is real but does not touch PDP [V]:**
`node_modules/…/app/components/_app/index.jsx:216` computes `const isCheckout = /\/checkout$/.test(location?.pathname)`,
then `:403` swaps `Header` → `CheckoutHeader` and `:484` `{!isCheckout ? <Footer /> : <CheckoutFooter />}`.
`/product/:productId` never matches that regex, so PDP always gets the normal Header/Footer.
**No PDP equivalent of this trap exists.** **[V]**

**Two adjacent things worth knowing anyway [V]:**
1. **`<Island hydrateOn='visible'>`.** Base wraps `ProductView`, `InformationAccordion`, and all three
   `RecommendedProducts` in `<Island>` (`product-detail/index.jsx:674, 788, 816, 831, 846`) — deferred
   hydration. Our override uses no Island. If PDP work reintroduces base components, they will hydrate
   eagerly unless Island is reintroduced too. Relevant to the ≤2s p75 mobile LCP budget in AGENTS.md.
2. **Set/bundle branch.** `product-detail/index.jsx:672` renders a structurally different tree for
   `isProductASet || isProductABundle` (per-child `ProductView` + `InformationAccordion`). Our override
   renders one shape for every product type, so a set or bundle SKU will render as a plain product. Not
   an override-bypass — a functional gap. **[V]**
3. `ProductView` is rendered from 6 places, not just PDP (`product-view-modal/index.jsx`,
   `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx`, + tests). An override of it
   is a Tier-2-scale blast radius, not a PDP-local change. **[V]**

## 5. Data layer

**Rule** (`.claude/rules/components.md` > Composition): anything under `overrides/app/components/`
receives data as props and calls **no** data-fetching hook — not `useProduct`, not any
`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` / React Query hook. Fetching lives in `overrides/app/pages/`. **[V]**

**The PDP obeys this today** — `useProduct`/`useCategory` are called only in
`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:21-31`; `PdpProductInfo`, `Breadcrumb` and
`ZimmPageToolbar` are all pure prop-driven. **[V]**

**Type chain [V]:**

```
useProduct  →  node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/hooks/ShopperProducts/query.d.ts:28
               UseQueryResult<DataType<Client['getProduct']>>
            →  commerce-sdk-isomorphic ShopperProductsModelTypes.Product
               (node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.esm.d.ts:59783-59835)
```

Fields the PDP already reads, all optional on the type: `id: string` (the only required one), `name?`,
`price?`, `currency?`, `shortDescription?`, `longDescription?`, `primaryCategoryId?`. Also available and
unused: `imageGroups?: Array<ImageGroup>`, `variants?`, `variationAttributes?`, `variationValues?`,
`master?`, `inventory?`/`inventories?`, `type?: ProductType`, `setProducts?`, `bundledProducts?`,
`productPromotions?`, `priceRanges?`, `prices?`, `pageMetaTags?`, `slugUrl?`. **[V]**

**Custom SFCC attributes.** The type ends in `& { [key: string]: any }` (`index.esm.d.ts:59834`), so any
`c_*` attribute typechecks as `any` for free. The repo deliberately does **not** rely on that — it
declares a narrowed intersection type instead:

```ts
// overrides/app/types/commerce.ts:7-10
export type ProductWithSizeFit = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useProduct>['data']> & {
  c_sizeFit?: string;
};
```

Used at `product-detail/index.tsx:78` as `(product as ProductWithSizeFit | undefined)?.c_sizeFit`.
**Copy this pattern for every new `c_*` attribute** — add the field to `commerce.ts`, re-export from
`types/index.ts`. It satisfies AGENTS.md > Type Definitions ("don't re-declare types already exported by
`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`") by deriving from `ReturnType<typeof useProduct>` rather than restating it. **[V]**

**Category shape:** `useCategory(...).data.parentCategoryTree` → `Array<PathRecord>` where
`PathRecord = {id?: string; name?: string}` (`index.esm.d.ts:~59860`). The PDP narrows it to a local
`BreadcrumbCategory {id: string; name: string}` with a type predicate at `index.tsx:38-40`. **[V]**

**Mocking policy.** AGENTS.md > Rules: no MSW / hardcoded fixtures in **production paths**. Stories and
tests are not production paths — `index.stories.tsx:4` imports
`mockStandardProductOrderable` from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/mocks/standard-product` and that is
compliant. **[V]**

### 6d. What a new PDP component is actually required to have

Per `.claude/rules/testing.md` and `.claude/rules/components.md` > Storybook **[V]**:

| Layer | Required? |

| `play` fn inside the story | Only when there is interactive behaviour worth asserting (validation on blur, disclosure open/close, focus movement, controlled-input wiring). | `*.test.ts` (Vitest) | Only when failure would be non-obvious or costly: data mapping, integration boundaries, complex state, pure logic that survives a refactor invisibly. | `.feature` + Playwright spec | For a new user journey. Gherkin first, **Lead QA signs off the `.feature` before any Playwright is written** (`.claude/skills/qa-generate/`). Tag every `test()` with both `@<area>` and `@SFCC-NNN`. |

shared components"). `Pages/` for the full page assembly. Titles in use today are all consistent with

enforced by `semgrep.yml`. `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:43,54` already does this with
